Tinkee can be found at flame crest. Thats all the way at the top (NORTHwest)of the  alliance FP. just pasted the ruins.

I had no problem finding the appropriate young dragons in the southern end of the burn steppes.  You will find one roaming 50 elite drake in the area, as well as worgs and scropions.  I did the eight kills in about 15-20 minutes.
